pairs.why: B's booth is chunkier, with a width-to-height ratio near the real kiosk's and a fuller domed top, while A is slimmer and taller.
A has straight planar walls, crisp corners and a tight tower like the real lighthouse and castle, while B is warped and swollen like a blob.
A is a plain armless chair with thin straight tubes and a flat backrest panel, like the real chair, while B adds puffy piped arms and rounded edges.
B has a wider base and thicker, more compact arms and stem, like the chunky real lamp, while A is thin-armed and tall, but both are plausible.
Both chairs share the same frame, proportions and thin tubes, so shape gives no reason to choose.
A is a round, flat wall clock with a thick rim, like the real one, while B is an oval freestanding blob.
A has a thicker slab top and chunkier stools, closer to the real heavy stone slab and stools, while B's top is thinner and its stools are waisted.
B is an armless chair with a flat back panel and thin tubes like the real one, while A adds arms and puffy rounded edges.
